svg.title: A taste map on a page
svg.desc: A page with sweetness running across and nuttiness running up, each from 0 to 1. Lemon juice sits at sweetness 0.1 and nuttiness 0, with black coffee directly above it at nuttiness 0.6. Orange juice sits at sweetness 0.8 and nuttiness 0. The latte sits at sweetness 0.4 and nuttiness 0.4, a little below the black coffee. The hazelnut latte sits at sweetness 0.6 and nuttiness 0.9.
